_meta.description: marketing-campaign-on-client D1: a touchpoint names the client and the landing page; contact and client carry the first and last touch of their form submissions, written by TouchpointService::recordSubmission(). A website form submit is a touchpoint whether or not its campaign value names a pipelinq campaign, so campaignId is no longer required.
